dateAssessment: Working year 1749 comes from YAML. July 5 is used only for the party’s crater-aftermath frame; the earlier imperial reports have no established absolute dates. July 9 and August 6 are spoken anchors. Civil August 7 follows the post-midnight Dream and the continuous 2 AM–9 AM scouting sequence; the narrator’s “night of August 6th” label is retained in t16. The rough three-day voyage and three-to-four-week downtime are compatible with the YAML span, without proving its earliest boundary or supplying an exact total of 33 transitions. Hektor/Vola events remain inside downtime, a couple days before Sura’s summons. The retrospectively confirmed sanctum rest has no stated duration or dated overnight.
